Phase 1: Core Layout & Framework Setup (HTML/Tailwind)
​Prompt:
"Create a single-file HTML web application for a political election strategy game set in Bangladesh. Use Tailwind CSS for a modern dark-mode glassmorphic UI (deep emerald and crimson accents). Include a top header tracking Campaign Funds, Current Campaign Week (out of 12), and Projected Parliament Seats (out of 300). Provide a clean grid layout with a left sidebar for party hierarchy and a main central panel."
​Phase 2: Adding the 64-District Map & Constituency Engine
​Prompt:
"Upgrade the game code to include an interactive grid/selector for all 64 districts of Bangladesh (from Dhaka, Chattogram, Sylhet, to Rajshahi, Khulna, Rangpur, Barishal, Mymensingh). Each district card must display its local district name, allocated parliamentary seats, current voter support percentage bar, and an interactive click handler that loads district-specific campaign actions like 'Hold Grand Rally' and 'Deploy Ground Cadres'."
​Phase 3: Crowdfunding & Public Donations
​Prompt:
"Add a Crowdfunding & Public Donation system to the game. Players start with a low campaign war chest and can click a button labeled 'Launch Public Donation Drive' to raise campaign funds (e.g., +৳30 Lakh) through public micro-donations and student rallies. Ensure every campaign action subtracts funds appropriately."
​Phase 4: Party Hierarchy (Chief Whip & Successor System)
​Prompt:
"Add a Party Leadership & Hierarchy panel to the left sidebar featuring:
​1. Chief Whip: Displays a designated whip offering a constituency discipline boost bonus.
​2. Party Successor / Vice President: Displays a second-in-command providing anti-smear shielding and morale defense.
Include clean UI cards with status tags for each leadership role."
​Phase 5: Turn-Based Campaign Progression & Election Night
​Prompt:
"Implement a turn-based campaign loop with an 'Advance Campaign Week' button that progresses the game up to Week 12. Upon reaching Week 12, trigger an Election Night modal that tallies votes across all 64 districts and determines whether the player wins an absolute majority (151+ seats), forms a coalition, or enters the opposition."
